census.claim: The agent searched 'Dire Maul release date World of Warcraft' instead of a query specifying the original/vanilla release date, so the search returned the WoW Classic release date (October 15, 2019) rather than the original 2006 release date.
The agent stated that Dire Maul was originally released on October 15, 2019 (the WoW Classic release date) instead of the correct original World of Warcraft release date of March 7, 2006.
